periods.description: Copper output reported for fiscal years 2024 and 2025; these are observation years, not opening or closure dates.
Spence copper production is reported for FY2025; the neighboring Cerro Colorado mine remains on care and maintenance.
The FY2025 report identifies Olympic Dam as an operating copper, gold, silver and uranium mine; production resumed after a two-week power outage.
BHP reports copper and zinc production at Antamina in FY2025.
The operator reports copper, gold and silver mine production for both calendar years 2024 and 2025.
Marketable bauxite mine output is reported for calendar years 2024 and 2025.

Rio Tinto Q2 2026 production tables report positive marketable bauxite mine output in both Q1 and Q2 2026 for Weipa. This is mine-level actual production on a 100% basis, not shipments, alumina refinery output, guidance or total regional production.
Marketable bauxite mine output is reported for calendar years 2024 and 2025.

Rio Tinto Q2 2026 production tables report positive marketable bauxite mine output in both Q1 and Q2 2026 for Gove. This is mine-level actual production on a 100% basis, not shipments, alumina refinery output, guidance or total regional production.
Marketable bauxite mine output is reported for calendar years 2024 and 2025.

Rio Tinto Q2 2026 production tables report positive marketable bauxite mine output in both Q1 and Q2 2026 for CBG Sangaredi. This is mine-level actual production on a 100% basis, not shipments, alumina refinery output, guidance or total regional production.
The 2025 filing reports copper and molybdenum production for each year from 2023 through 2025.
Copper and molybdenum production is reported separately for 2023, 2024 and 2025.
Copper and gold mining is documented in 2025. The September mud-rush interruption and October restart of unaffected mines occurred within this annual observation.
Mine-level annual gold production is reported for 2024 and 2025; copper co-production is also reported for both years.
Mine-level annual gold production is reported for 2024 and 2025; copper co-production is also reported for both years.
Mine-level annual gold production is reported for 2024 and 2025.
Annual copper and gold production is reported in both 2024 and 2025. The 2025 S3 expansion is not treated as the mine opening.
The operator reports copper output in 2024 and 2025 and describes ore mined from different pit stages.
CMOC documents operating copper-cobalt mining and five working production lines at TFM at the end of 2025.
Annual copper production is reported for every year from 2021 through 2025. Temporary 2025 flooding interruptions are within the annual reporting interval.
MP Materials reports rare-earth concentrate output at Mountain Pass in 2024 and 2025.

MP Materials reports 11,072 tonnes of REO contained in concentrate produced in the quarter ended 30 June 2026. The operator defines this as an upstream mining and processing indicator at Mountain Pass; separated NdPr and magnet manufacture are not substituted for extraction evidence.
Lithium carbonate production is attested in 2024 and 2025; the 2025 result is 34,100 tonnes, 34% above 2024.

Lithium Argentina reports 9,280 tonnes of lithium carbonate produced at Cauchari-Olaroz in Q2 2026. The source documents an operating brine project and a completed May maintenance shutdown; annual visibility indicates some operation during 2026, not uninterrupted daily production or planned Stage 2 capacity.
Rio Tinto reports actual Fénix lithium-carbonate output and full-capacity operation during the fourth quarter of 2025.

Rio Tinto reports actual first lithium production from the Fénix 1B expansion during Q2 2026 at the existing Fénix operation. The expansion attests activity in 2026; it is not treated as the original mine opening and no combined Fénix/Olaroz tonnage is assigned to this site.
Albemarle reports positive Greenbushes lithium extraction production in 2025, extending the existing independently documented history by one observed year.

IGO reports 351 kt of spodumene production at Greenbushes in the quarter ended 31 March 2026 and describes contemporaneous mining, stripping and mine-to-mill operations. This is an observed partial year; downstream Kwinana refinery output and full-year guidance are excluded.
Albemarle reports lithium extraction at its Salar de Atacama operation separately for 2023, 2024 and 2025.
Cameco reports uranium mine production in 2025; this observed year does not erase earlier shutdown periods.
Actual second-quarter 2026 uranium production is reported. This observation does not assert production for the unreported remainder of the year.
Cameco reports uranium mine production in 2025; this observed year does not erase earlier shutdown periods.
Actual second-quarter 2026 uranium production is reported. This observation does not assert production for the unreported remainder of the year.
Glencore reports nickel and cobalt production from Murrin Murrin’s own sources in 2024 and 2025.
